sop_markdown:
# Insert Item into Vase

Place an item into a vase, ensuring proper alignment and preventing spills.

## Before you start
- Gather the item to be inserted.
- Locate the vase on your right.
- Ensure the vase opening is clear.

## 1. **Insert into vase**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.  
**Why:** Align the item with the vase opening to avoid spillage. *(inferred)*

## 2. **Insert into vase**
Push the item held in the right hand into the vase on your right.  
**Why:** The left side parts are already sorted, so I check them before placing into the tray. *(expert)*

## Check your work
- Verify the item sits securely inside the vase.
- Ensure no spillage or misalignment occurred.

quiz.q: Why should you align the item with the vase opening before inserting?
choices: To make the vase look neat
quiz.explain: Aligning prevents the item from falling out or spilling.

quiz.q: Why check the left side parts before placing the item into the tray?
choices: To avoid damaging the left side parts
To ensure the tray is empty
quiz.explain: Checking prevents accidental damage to already sorted parts.

quiz.q: Why hold the item steady while inserting?
choices: To maintain control and avoid spills
To keep the item from spinning
To make the insertion look professional
quiz.explain: A steady hand reduces the risk of spillage.

safety: Avoid spilling by aligning item with opening.
Check adjacent parts before insertion to prevent damage.
Hold items steadily to maintain control.
